svg.title: OCP RAS API demo CPER analysis and CPAD remediation flow
svg.desc: A presentation diagram showing CPERs flowing from the Redfish dev server RAS API plugin through an SDK event subscriber and analysis orchestrator to the Contoso analyzer. Proposed CPADs flow through the operator policy engine and, when approved, back to the server.
svg.text: OCP RAS API Demo — CPER Analysis & CPAD Remediation Loop
Errors flow out as CPERs; approved remediation actions return as CPADs over standard Redfish interfaces.
Owns RAS resources, records and actions
